paragraphs: It is evening, and dinner is in the kitchen. Mom has an onion. She puts it in the rice. Tom drinks his milk at the table. He is nine years old. Dad is on the phone. He talks to Grandma. Lily sits on the floor. Pip sits on the mat next to the door.

"Who wants an onion?" says Mom. "Not me!" says Tom. Tom smiles at his milk. "Do you like onions, Lily?" asks Mom. "Yes, I do," says Lily. "Grandma says hello," says Dad. Pip goes to the hall. There is a mirror on the wall. Pip sees a small brown dog!

"Woof!" says Pip. The dog in the mirror says, "Woof!" Pip looks at him with big eyes. Lily comes to the hall. "That is you, Pip," she says. "You are small and brown, with a happy face." Pip is happy now. The dog in the mirror is happy too! Now Mom says, "Dinner!" Pip runs to the kitchen. The family smiles.
text.summary: It is evening, and dinner is in the kitchen, and each person in the family does one thing. Pip sees a dog in the hall mirror, and Lily shows him it is Pip.
